import sys, random, json, importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
import ref, gen
src = open('/tmp/gen4.py').read().replace("main()\n","")
g4 = type(sys)('g4'); exec(compile(src,'g4','exec'), g4.__dict__)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
seed = int(sys.argv[1]); target = int(sys.argv[2])
rng = random.Random(seed)
for i in range(target+1):
    doc=None
    while doc is None:
        K = rng.choice([4,5,6,8,10,12,16,20,24])
        doc = g4.make_doc(rng, K, rng.randint(0,6), rng.randint(2,4), rng.randint(1,4), rng.randint(0,6), maxcore=16 if K<=12 else 10**9)
    doc = json.loads(json.dumps(doc))
    if i != target: continue

    ixps, rib, priors, declared, order, queries = m._parse(doc)
    agg = {}
    for p,c in rib:
        n = m._normalize(p, ixps)
        if len(n)<2 or len(set(n))!=len(n): continue
        agg[tuple(n)] = agg.get(tuple(n),0)+c
    al, rounds, surv = m._peel(list(agg.items()))
    core = set()
    for p,_c in surv:
        for j in range(len(p)-1): core.add(m._canon(p[j],p[j+1]))
    cl2 = sorted({ref.canon(p[j],p[j+1]) for p in ref.peel_naive(ref.aggregate([(tuple(r['path']),r['count']) for r in rib], ixps))[2] for j in range(len(p)-1)})
    print('core main == ref:', sorted(core)==cl2, len(core), len(cl2))
    var_index = {e:i for i,e in enumerate(sorted(core))}
    final_agg={}
    for p,c in surv: final_agg[p]=final_agg.get(p,0)+c
    occ = m._occurrences(list(final_agg.items()), var_index, len(core))
    scopes=[]
    for e in range(len(core)):
        ctx=set()
        for (lk,rk) in occ[e]:
            if lk[0] in (1,2): ctx.add(lk[1])
            if rk[0] in (1,2): ctx.add(rk[1])
        scopes.append(tuple(sorted(ctx|{e})))
    hscopes = gen.scopes_of(cl2, ref.peel_naive(ref.aggregate([(tuple(r['path']),r['count']) for r in rib], ixps))[2])
    print('scopes equal:', scopes==hscopes)
    print('max scope size', max(len(s) for s in scopes))
    ov = [var_index[tuple(x)] for x in order]
    # width by main
    adj=[set() for _ in range(len(core))]
    for s in scopes:
        for x in range(len(s)):
            for y in range(x+1,len(s)):
                adj[s[x]].add(s[y]); adj[s[y]].add(s[x])
    done=set(); mx=0
    for v in ov:
        nb = adj[v]-done; mx=max(mx,len(nb))
        nl=list(nb)
        for a in range(len(nl)):
            for b in range(a+1,len(nl)):
                adj[nl[a]].add(nl[b]); adj[nl[b]].add(nl[a])
        done.add(v)
    print('max width', mx)
    print('order', order)
